about: Band-pass Q of the Analog Rytm MKII's analog filter against the resonance word the filter routine sends (frame +74 + 2v), measured on a unit (Nathaniel Pavel's MKII, OS 1.74, 22 Nov 2026) with the private Filter Probe: white noise into the BD voice, the BD voice's USB channel recorded, each step fitted with a 2-pole band-pass. Values are the mean of the runs at 220 Hz, 880 Hz and 3.5 kHz where the band was inside 25 Hz..16 kHz. Stock's RES knob sends value x 256 (0x0000..0x7f00); words from 0x8000 are below RES 0 (the word is signed).
